verses.1: The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
verses.2: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
verses.3: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.
verses.4: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.
verses.5: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.6: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.
verses.7: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!
verses.8: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgements, LORD.
verses.9: For you, LORD, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.
verses.10: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.11: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.12: Be glad in the LORD, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
